title: Dean Cornwell Panoramic Sketch
content: Up for auction right now is an unusual preliminary sketch by Dean Cornwell.The panoramic gouache painting is 6" x 83", matted and framed. Cornwell painted it in preparation for the mural "Telephone Men and Women at Work" in Boston in 1951.The 190-foot mural circles the lobby, with 197 life-size portraits telling the story of the history of the telephone.Such a monumental mural requires a lot of planning. Cornwell produced a series of small sketches, first to get hired for the project, and then to plan the figure groupings.Cornwell gave the original gouache sketch to teacher and painter Jack Faragasso, who turned 90 recently and has preserved the sketch all these years.----Online Auction:Christies Dean Cornwell Sketchthrough May 22Book by:Jack Faragasso:The Student's Guide to PaintingBook:The Art of Dean Cornwell
